subject: SOC 2 Type II request — minimal deliverables, audit-window clarification, and reply templates
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@acme-digital.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: security@acme-digital.com
Date: Sun, 7 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II report request — initial ask

Hi Soojin,

We're starting quarterly vendor reviews and need a copy of Redwood's most recent SOC 2 Type II report covering Controls for the period that includes 2024-10-01 through 2025-03-31 (our audit window). Could you share the report (or an alternate certified package) and a short bridge letter if the report period doesn't fully align?

A few additional asks:
- Minimal artifacts we can expect (control mappings, org chart, evidence index)
- If you provide redacted copies or SFTP/Drive transfer guidance
- Any telemetry snapshots or logging samples for May 2025 (we audit sample logs)

We're on a tight review timeline — would appreciate initial guidance today or tomorrow.

Thanks,
Alice Nguyen
Vendor Security Manager
Acme Digital
security@acme-digital.com

P.S. If it's easier, a short templated reply we can attach to the RFP will speed things up when we loop procurement.
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@acme-digital.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 7 Sep 2025 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request — initial ask

Hi Alice — thanks for the note and the timeline. I can get you an initial package and options by EOD tomorrow. Summary below to set expectations and speed your review: 

1) What we can provide now (low-friction):
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) covering the auditor's opinion and scope.
- Bridge letter template if the report periods don't match your required window.
- A one-page evidence index (what's in-scope and where to request artifacts).

2) Typical supplemental artifacts (available on request):
- Control mapping spreadsheet (showing controls -> evidence artifacts).
- Redacted telemetry/log samples (we provide sampling instructions; PII redaction is applied).
- Org chart and key policy PDFs (info security, incident response).

3) Transfer options:
- Secure Drive folder (preferred) with link expiration and viewer restrictions.
- SFTP/Aspera for larger bundles.
- We do not send raw logs via email.

4) Telemetry samples / May 2025:
- We can provide pre-filtered log snapshots for the requested time-range, along with a README that explains sampling/aggregation. Please confirm the exact event classes you need (e.g., auth events, API request traces, KV cache evictions).

5) Quick reply templates: attached are two short templates — one for procurement and one for security intake. Use whichever fits your workflow.

Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_Minimum_Ask.xlsx (minimal artifact list), Bridge_Letter_Sample.docx, Telemetry_Sample_Instructions.pdf

Next steps: If you confirm the audit window you need us to cover (or tell us if the auditor will accept a bridge letter), we'll prioritize packaging the right artifacts.

Best,

— Soojin Lee
Lead, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142
From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@acme-digital.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acme-digital.com
Date: Mon, 8 Sep 2025 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request — initial ask

Thanks Soojin — that helps. A couple clarifications from our side: 

- Our auditors prefer evidence that covers 2024-10-01 through 2025-03-31. If your latest report ends earlier, the bridge letter will be necessary.
- For telemetry samples: we specifically need auth success/failure events and API request traces for the May 2025 period. CSV or NDJSON is fine as long as timestamps and request IDs are preserved. Redaction of user-identifiable fields is OK — please document what was redacted.

One more ask: can you include short, copy-ready language (2–3 lines) we can paste into our procurement portal that summarizes Redwood's coverage and where the artifacts are stored?

If you can send the initial package and that copy by tomorrow EOD Pacific, we'll be set to move this through procurement next week.

Appreciate it,
Alice
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@acme-digital.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 9 Sep 2025 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II request — package and copy for procurement

Alice — attaching the initial package link and a short procurement blurb below. We prepared the minimum deliverables to satisfy a first pass review; if your auditors request deeper artifacts we can escalate.

Transfer link (secure folder): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cACME-SOC2 (expires 2025-10-09)

Procurement / intake copy (2–3 lines):
"Redwood Inference provides a SOC 2 Type II report covering security and availability controls for the audited period; an accompanying evidence index and redacted telemetry samples are available in a secure folder. Contact compliance@redwood.com to request additional artifacts or arrange an SFTP transfer."

Notes on telemetry: we included pre-filtered auth events and API traces for May 2025. Export format: NDJSON (each line is a JSON event). We documented redaction and sampling methodology in Telemetry_Sample_Instructions.pdf inside the folder.

Attachments included in the Drive folder: SOC2_TypeII_Report.pdf (redacted), SOC2_TypeII_Minimum_Ask.xlsx, Bridge_Letter_Sample.docx, Telemetry_Sample_Instructions.pdf, Evidence_Index.csv

If you need a signed bridge letter, we'll route to our legal team and can typically deliver within 3 business days.

Kimberly/Dylan — looping you for visibility in case Acme requests the signed bridge or additional artifacts.

Best,
— Soojin
